# simplifyd_ipsec_connection (Resource)

A site-to-site IPsec tunnel on a VPN gateway service.

Changes are stored when applied but reach the running gateway on its next deployment. A tunnel without a pre-shared key comes up and fails authentication, so set `psk` unless the counterparty's key is being loaded another way.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplifyd_service" "vpn" {
  name = "partner-vpn"
  type = "ipsec_gateway"
}

# The counterparty configures simplifyd_service.vpn.ipsec_gateway.public_ip as
# their peer address — it is fixed for the gateway's life.
resource "simplifyd_ipsec_connection" "partner" {
  service        = simplifyd_service.vpn.slug
  name           = "partner-a"
  remote_gateway = "203.0.113.10"
  remote_subnets = ["192.168.50.0/24"]

  # Counterparties routinely mandate an exact algorithm set.
  ike_proposal = "aes256-sha256-modp2048"
  esp_proposal = "aes256-sha256-modp2048"

  # Write-only at the API, so it lives in state: source it from a secret store,
  # not a literal. Changing it rotates the key on the next gateway deployment.
  psk = var.partner_psk
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connection name, used in the gateway's swanctl configuration.
- `remote_gateway` (String) Counterparty's public IKE endpoint (address or hostname).
- `remote_subnets` (List of String) Ranges reachable through the counterparty. At least one is required.
- `service` (String) Slug of the `ipsec_gateway` service terminating this tunnel.

### Optional

- `env` (String) Environment slug. Defaults to the provider's `env`, or to the environment the API token is scoped to. Workspace and project are not configurable — they come from the token.
- `esp_proposal` (String) ESP (phase 2) algorithm proposal.
- `ike_lifetime` (String) IKE SA lifetime, e.g. `4h`.
- `ike_proposal` (String) IKE (phase 1) algorithm proposal, e.g. `aes256-sha256-modp2048`. Counterparties routinely mandate an exact set.
- `lifetime` (String) Child SA lifetime, e.g. `1h`.
- `local_id` (String) IKE identity this side presents. Defaults to the gateway's public address.
- `local_subnets` (List of String) Narrows the gateway's own local subnets for this tunnel. Omit to inherit the gateway's set.
- `psk` (String, Sensitive) Pre-shared key. Write-only: the API never returns it, so it is stored in Terraform state and compared from there — source it from a secret store rather than a literal. Changing it rotates the key, which takes effect on the gateway's next deployment.
- `remote_id` (String) IKE identity expected from the counterparty.
- `start_action` (String) What the gateway does with the tunnel on load: `start`, `trap`, or `none`.

### Read-Only

- `has_psk` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a pre-shared key for this tunnel.
- `id` (String) `<workspace>/<project>/<env>/<gateway>/<connection>`.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Connections are identified by <workspace>/<project>/<env>/<gateway>/<connection>.
terraform import simplifyd_ipsec_connection.partner 0192f3a1-6c4e-7a10-9b2d-3f8c1a5e7b04/0192f3a1-8d21-7c33-af14-6b90e2d45c77/0192f3a1-9e55-7f08-b3c6-1d47a8e90f21/partner-vpn/0192f3a2-44c1-7b90-9d1e-5c8b2f0a7d63

# The pre-shared key is never returned by the API, so an imported connection has
# no psk in state. Set it in configuration and apply to rotate it.
```
